links.text: Listen to information about second class transfer.

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30115-01.htm.text: Grand Magister Jurek: Hello there, have you come to learn how to enhance the abilities of your weapon?

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30115-03.htm.text: Grand Magister Jurek: You must hurry and collect the souls of evil creatures in the soul crystal. You will find the evil ones in the northern part of Oren, the Forest of Mirrors, the Cave of Giants, the Devastated Castle, the higher reaches of the Tower of Insolence, deep within the Lair of Anthara…

links.text: Ask about the evil creatures from which you will collect souls.

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30115-21.htm.text: Grand Magister Jurek: How is your mission going? Oh, I see that you need a new crystal!

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30115-02.html.text: Grand Magister Jurek: Not long after I arrived in Giran frightening monsters began to gather in the corridor to the north. During this time I learned that the creatures using magic were not originally magic users. I can't be sure, but I sense the complicity of Dark Magician Hardin. As you know, his…

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30115-03.html.text: Grand Magister Jurek: Good. Take this mark for now. I will tell you about the monsters that you must investigate. First, we have the Monster Eye Destroyers . There are many of them in the Wasteland and the Plains of Dion. Please bring back 5 of their hides. Second, we have the Breka Orc Shamans . Y…

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30115-02.htm.text: Grand Magister Jurek: I have a growing sense of dread of late. Something terrible is coming. Can you hear it? The trees in the forest, the birds in the sky and the fish in the ocean...They know of what I speak... I fear for the survival of the whole Human race, but I don't know what threatens it! T…

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30115-04.htm.text: Grand Magister Jurek: Oh, marvelous! If we all develop our strengths and work together, we will triumph over the coming cataclysm. My colleagues and I have recently developed a method of enhancing weaponry that should prove quite useful to all of us. This weapons enhancement boosts strength noticea…

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30115-05.htm.text: Grand Magister Jurek: To enhance a weapon you will need some magical souls. You must collect the souls of evil creatures and trap them in the soul crystal I will give you. You will then take the crystal to a blacksmith and he will extract the magic from the crystal and apply it to a weapon for you.…

links.text: "How do I collect the souls of the evil ones?"

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30115-06.htm.text: Grand Magister Jurek: After you have sapped the evil one's strength in battle, apply the crystal to his skin. His soul will be absorbed into the crystal. His mortal body is easily dispatched. Each soul crystal can contain up to 10 souls. A more precise explanation would be that it can contain up to…

links.text: What are the precautions to take when collecting souls?"

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30115-07.htm.text: Grand Magister Jurek: The collection of a soul doesn't always go as planned. Some evil souls will simply not be absorbed, and, if you happen to collect the wrong soul, the crystal will shatter... Soul crystals develop refined tastes, and will reject weaker souls after a while. When this happens you…

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30115-08.htm.text: Grand Magister Jurek: Please choose one of the following three types of crystals: Each crystal bestows a different power upon the weapon it enhances, and the powers may vary from weapon to weapon.

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30115-09.htm.text: Grand Magister Jurek: Here is a red soul crystal. Collect souls into it and take it to a blacksmith along with the weapon you wish to enhance. The stronger the weapon, the more souls needed to enhance it. Next time we meet I hope you have gained more strength.

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30115-10.htm.text: Grand Magister Jurek: Here is a green soul crystal. Collect souls into it and take it to a blacksmith along with the weapon you wish to enhance. The stronger the weapon, the more souls needed to enhance it. Next time we meet I hope you have gained more strength.

Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon/30115-11.htm.text: Grand Magister Jurek: Here is a blue soul crystal. Collect souls into it and take it to a blacksmith along with the weapon you wish to enhance. The stronger the weapon, the more souls needed to enhance it. Next time we meet I hope you have gained more strength.
